topics.title: Describing motion: position, point objects and average velocity

concepts.learning_objective: Explain when a moving body can be treated as a point object and what kinematics studies.
Distinguish average speed from average velocity and compare their magnitudes.
Find instantaneous velocity as the limit of average velocity, v = dx/dt.
Interpret instantaneous velocity as the slope of the tangent to the x-t graph.
Define average and instantaneous acceleration and relate their sign to the chosen axis.
Use the slope and area of a v-t graph to obtain acceleration and displacement.

topics.title: Kinematic equations for uniformly accelerated motion

concepts.learning_objective: Apply v = v0 + at, x = v0t + at^2/2 and v^2 = v0^2 + 2ax with proper signs.
State the conditions under which the kinematic equations are valid.

topics.title: Applications: free fall, Galileo's law, stopping distance and reaction time

concepts.learning_objective: Analyse vertical motion under gravity, including the top of the path.
Use kinematics to estimate stopping distance and reaction time.
